svg.title: Steam Operating System Survey September and October 2026 waffle chart
svg.desc: Two 100-cell waffle grids show September 95 Windows, 3 Linux and 2 macOS cells, and October 94 Windows, 4 Linux and 2 macOS cells, after whole-cell rounding. Precise October survey percentages are 93.70 Windows, 3.95 Linux and 2.35 macOS; September 95.03 Windows, 3.05 Linux, 1.92 macOS. Values are shares of an optional anonymous Steam survey, not total PC or global market share.
svg.text: LINUX NEARS 4% OF STEAM SURVEY SYSTEMS
SmartChart #30 · 100 equal cells per month · Valve Hardware & Software Survey, Oct. 2026
Full October shares: Windows 93.70% | Linux 3.95% | macOS 2.35%.
Source: Valve Steam Hardware & Software Survey, October 2026. Cell counts are rounded; participation is optional and anonymous.
